hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r c; case "$c" in git\ push*origin*main*) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Direct push to main is forbidden. Open a PR instead."}'; exit 0;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for direct push to main

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" && pnpm exec eslint "$f" --fix;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
